LEVA-ZSHB(1)              General Commands Manual              LEVA-ZSHB(1)

NAME
     leva-zshb - sample shell builtins, zsh layout

SHELL BUILTIN COMMANDS
     - simple command
             Marks the next word as a plain command, so no wrapper changes how it is
             run.

     . file [ arg ... ]
     source file [ arg ... ]
             Reads commands from file and runs them in the current shell.  Any
             arguments become the positional parameters while it runs.

     alias [ -gmrsL ] [ name[=value] ... ]
             Defines or lists aliases.  Without arguments every alias is printed.

             -g      Make the alias global.

                     It is replaced anywhere in a command line.

             -L      Print each alias in a form that can be read back as input.
     echo [ -neE ] [ arg ... ]
             Writes the arguments separated by spaces, followed by a newline. Escape
             handling depends on the options.
     print [ -nr ] [ arg ... ]
     print -f format [ arg ... ]
             Writes the arguments to the terminal, like echo but with more options.

     true  Does nothing and succeeds.
             It always exits with status zero.
     unalias name ...
             Removes the named aliases.
